tour.title: Welcome to Fluently
tour.1: Each grammar topic starts with a short rule page. Read it first.
tour.2: Then warm up with 10 quick cards: guess the word and tap to check.
tour.3: Finally, fix the mistakes in 10 short drills. Each one unlocks the next.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Fluently is a free IELTS practice website. This page explains, in plain words, what we keep and why.
privacy.what: When you sign in with Google, we store your name, your email address and your practice progress (rules read, cards turned, drill scores, your streak and your display settings).
privacy.why: We store it so your progress is saved and you can continue on any device.
privacy.email: We send you emails about new lessons and updates only if you tick the box that asks for them. If you did not tick it, we never use your email address for messages.
privacy.optout: Open the profile menu (your name, top right) and turn off "Send me new lessons and updates by email". You can turn it on again at any time.
privacy.delete: To delete your account and all your progress, email {email} from the address you sign in with. We will delete it and reply to confirm.
privacy.sell_h: We do not sell your data
privacy.sell: We never sell or share your data with anyone.
privacy.firebase: Fluently uses Google Firebase for sign-in and to store your progress securely.
privacy.howto: Questions about your data? Email us at the address above.
